# apple_bundle_id (Data Source)

Looks up a bundle ID by its App Store Connect ID or its bundle identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_bundle_id" "app" {
  identifier = "com.example.app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the bundle ID. Set this or `identifier`.
- `identifier` (String) Bundle identifier, e.g. `com.example.app`. Set this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Name of the bundle ID.
- `platform` (String) Platform of the bundle ID.
- `seed_id` (String) App ID prefix.
